name: yls-schema-loader
description: Discovers yaml-language-server schemas for Kubernetes-style YAML documents and helps wire them up.

commands.title: YLS Schema Loader: Insert Schema for Current Document

ylsSchemaLoader.insertionMode.description: What to write when a schema is resolved: an inline yaml-language-server comment, a yaml.schemas entry, or both.

ylsSchemaLoader.enableWebDiscovery.description: Search GitHub for a matching schema when no bundled mapping or cached resolution exists.

ylsSchemaLoader.additionalMappings.description: User/workspace overrides merged on top of the bundled kind/apiVersion to schema URL mapping.

ylsSchemaLoader.githubRepoHints.description: Explicit apiVersion-group to org/repo overrides for cases the GitHub heuristic guesses wrong.

scripts.test:unit: test -z "$(find out/src/lib -name '*.test.js' 2>/dev/null)" && echo 'no unit tests yet' || mocha "out/src/lib/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
